Whenever you Help an Ally, you may spend a Command Token to use a d8 advantage instead of a d6.

Spend 3 Hope and target an adversary. Make an attack with Advantage against that adversary.

Whether your attack hits or misses, the next ally attack made against that adversary also gains Advantage.

Some people lead through rank. Others lead through fear. An Envoy leads through confidence, daring, and instinct. They inspire allies to push harder, exploit every weakness in the enemy's line, and turn a single opening into a decisive victory.
When you Help an ally, you also gain a Hope if they roll with Hope.
Once per Scene, after an ally succeeds on an Instinct Roll, you also learn what they learned.
You have Advantage on rolls to negotiate contracts, leverage bureaucracy, or interact with corporate officials.

Whenever you use a Command Token to Help an Ally to attack, apply the following effects depending on the action result:

  • If the attack succeeded, increase the damage die of that attack by one step (d6 -> d8, d8 -> d10, etc.).

  • If the attack missed, your ally may clear a Stress or gain a Hope.

If the attack defeats the chosen adversary, you gain a Hope.

When an adversary makes a ranged attack against one of your allies and before the dice are rolled, you can spend a Command Token to impose disadvantage to that attack. The disadvantage die is a d8 (instead of a d6).

When an ally within Very Close range makes a Action Roll but before the consequences are determined, you can spend a Command Token to make that ally roll again. They must keep the new result and you may not use another Command Token for that action.
Insectoid beings who thrive through cooperation and shared purpose.
Play the Captain if you want to lead from the front, empower your allies, and make teamwork your greatest weapon.

Your speech is imbued with power. After a long rest, place a number of tokens on this card equal to your Presence. When you speak with an ally, you can spend a token from this card to give them one benefit from the following options:

  • Your ally clears a Stress.

  • Your ally clears a Hit Point.

  • Your ally gains a Hope.

When you take a long rest, clear all unspent tokens.

system.description:
Being part of a corporateborne community means you were raised within the influence of a megacorporation. Whether as an executive's child or a factory worker, you learned that favors, contracts, and reputation often matter more than laws.

Corporateborne are often ambitious, composed, persuasive, polished, and calculating.
